title: Swizzle Whisper
tagline: Compare four matrix multiplication strategies with cache-aware cost models.

curves.label: Tiled GEMM
curves.code: for (ii=0;ii<n;ii+=T) for (jj=0;jj<n;jj+=T) for (kk=0;kk<n;kk+=T) for (i=ii;i<Math.min(ii+T,n);i++) for (k=kk;k<Math.min(kk+T,n);k++) for (j=jj;j<Math.min(jj+T,n);j++) C[i][j]+=A[i][k]*B[k][j];
curves.name: Tiled GEMM

curves.label: Strassen Variant
curves.code: /* Recursively split matrices into quadrants and combine 7 subproducts (with base-case cutoff). */ if(n<=cut){baseGEMM();} else { // compute M1..M7 via additions/subtractions; // assemble C11..C22; }
curves.name: Strassen Variant

curves.label: Winograd-ish
curves.code: /* Precompute linear transforms to reduce multiplications; keep additions-heavy schedule. */ precomputeU(); precomputeV(); for(i=0;i<n;i++) for(j=0;j<n;j++) C[i][j]=combine(U[i],V[j]);
curves.name: Winograd-ish
